description: This file defines a static class ResponseCompletionSourcePool that manages object pooling for ResponseCompletionSource objects, including generic versions for different result types, using concurrent object pools.

classes.name: ResponseCompletionSourcePool
classes.description: A static class providing pooled instances of ResponseCompletionSource objects, supporting both untyped and typed (generic) versions.

classes.name: TypedPool<T>
classes.description: A nested static class that holds a thread-safe pool of ResponseCompletionSource<T> objects.

methods.name: Get<T>
methods.description: Retrieves a ResponseCompletionSource<T> instance from the pool.

methods.name: Return<T>
methods.description: Returns a ResponseCompletionSource<T> instance to the pool.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an untyped ResponseCompletionSource instance from the pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns an untyped ResponseCompletionSource instance to the pool.
